whyEn: Exam weight 2/3. Hematologic emergencies rarely arrive as the primary complaint, but the chapter's real payoff is prehospital-relevant: transfusion thresholds and reaction recognition, sickle cell crisis management, DIC and hemophilia bleeding patterns, and — the highest-yield real-world scenario — why a 'minor' fall in a patient on warfarin or a DOAC is never minor. Expect numeric questions on Hgb/platelet transfusion triggers, crisis subtypes, and BC's actual (opioid-free) PCP pain-control options.
whyZh: 考试权重 2/3。血液系统急症很少作为主诉直接出现，但这一章真正的实战价值在别处：输血阈值与输血反应识别、镰状细胞危象处置、DIC 与血友病的出血模式——以及最高频的现实场景：华法林或新型口服抗凝药病人的「小」跌倒为什么从来都不小。数字题会考 Hgb/血小板输血触发点、危象亚型，以及 BC 考纲里 PCP 实际能用的（不含阿片类）镇痛选项。

points.en: Blood performs five jobs at once: carrying O2/CO2, ferrying nutrients, removing metabolic waste, distributing hormones and body heat, and carrying the immune cells and antibodies that fight infection.
points.zh: 血液一人身兼五职：运氧运二氧化碳、运送营养物、清运代谢废物、分发激素和体热、携带免疫细胞与抗体御敌。

points.en: Blood splits into plasma (55% of volume, 92% water) and formed elements (45%): RBCs, WBCs, and platelets — RBCs alone make up about 99% of the formed-element count.
points.zh: 血液分血浆（占血容量 55%，92% 是水）和有形成分（45%）：红细胞、白细胞、血小板——其中红细胞就占了有形成分数量的约 99%。

points.en: Three lab values anchor this chapter: RBC count, hemoglobin (g/L), and hematocrit (the proportion of blood made of RBCs) — a 'balanced' reading has hemoglobin at roughly one-third of hematocrit and RBC count at roughly one-third of hemoglobin.
points.zh: 本章围绕三项化验值展开：红细胞计数、血红蛋白（g/L）、血细胞比容（红细胞占血液的比例）——「协调」的读数是血红蛋白约为血细胞比容的三分之一，红细胞计数约为血红蛋白的三分之一。

points.en: Documentation habit: NSAIDs (aspirin, ibuprofen) and even some herbal supplements (ginkgo, garlic, ginger, ginseng, feverfew) impair platelet clumping — always ask about them alongside prescription anticoagulants.
points.zh: 问诊习惯：阿司匹林、布洛芬这类 NSAID，甚至银杏、大蒜、生姜、人参、小白菊这些草本补剂都会削弱血小板聚集——问药史时要连处方抗凝药一起问。

sections.titleEn: Cell Production, Clotting, and Blood Typing
sections.titleZh: 血细胞生成、凝血与血型

points.en: Bone marrow, liver, and spleen run the system: marrow makes cells (found in long bones, pelvis, skull, and vertebrae), the liver makes clotting factors and filters toxins, the spleen filters/destroys old RBCs and stores platelets.
points.zh: 骨髓、肝、脾三大件分工：骨髓造细胞（长骨、骨盆、颅骨、椎骨里都有）、肝脏造凝血因子并解毒、脾脏过滤销毁老化红细胞并储存血小板。

points.en: RBCs come from marrow stem cells, driven by kidney-secreted erythropoietin; maturation takes up to 5 days and the finished cell lives about 4 months before being recycled.
points.zh: 红细胞源自骨髓干细胞，由肾脏分泌的促红细胞生成素驱动生成；成熟最长要 5 天，成品寿命约 4 个月后被回收。

points.en: Platelets circulate about two-thirds of the time (the rest parked in the spleen) and live only 7-10 days — remove the spleen and the stored third rejoins the bloodstream.
points.zh: 血小板约三分之二在血液里循环，其余三分之一停在脾脏，寿命只有 7-10 天——切了脾，存的那部分就会回归血流。

points.en: A healthy adult churns out roughly 100 billion to 1 trillion (10^11-10^12) new blood cells every single day just to hold the peripheral count steady.
points.zh: 健康成人每天要造出约 1000 亿到 1 万亿个（10^11-10^12）新血细胞，才能把外周血细胞数稳住。

points.en: Clotting is two simultaneous acts: primary hemostasis (platelets plug the injury) and secondary hemostasis (the coagulation cascade builds fibrin strands that reinforce the plug) — the end result is a stable clot.
points.zh: 凝血是两幕同时上演：原发性止血（血小板堵住伤口）和继发性止血（凝血级联反应织出纤维蛋白丝加固血栓）——最终结果是一个稳定的血凝块。

points.en: WBCs (leukocytes) protect against invaders and are also marrow-derived; the normal adult range is 4.5-11.0 x10^9/L, and newly released granulocytes circulate only 6-12 hours before moving into tissue or being recycled.
points.zh: 白细胞负责抵御外敌，同样来自骨髓；成人正常范围 4.5-11.0×10^9/L，刚释放的粒细胞在血液里只循环 6-12 小时，之后要么进组织要么被回收。

points.en: ABO/Rh typing prevents transfusion disasters: type O is the universal RBC donor and type AB the universal RBC recipient — but for plasma the roles flip, AB donates to anyone and O can only receive from O.
points.zh: ABO/Rh 配型是为了防出输血事故：红细胞方面 O 型是万能供者、AB 型是万能受者——但血浆恰好反过来，AB 型血浆能供给任何人，O 型血浆只能收 O 型。

points.en: About 85-90% of people carry the Rh antigen (Rh-positive); an Rh-negative mother sensitized to Rh-positive fetal blood can develop antibodies that cause life-threatening fetal anemia in a later Rh-positive pregnancy.
points.zh: 约 85-90% 的人带 Rh 抗原（Rh 阳性）；Rh 阴性母亲若因胎儿 Rh 阳性血致敏产生抗体，会在后续怀 Rh 阳性胎儿时引发危及生命的胎儿贫血。

points.en: Watch transfusion patients hardest in the first 30-60 minutes — that is the typical window in which a transfusion reaction declares itself.
points.zh: 输血病人要在最初 30-60 分钟内盯得最紧——这是输血反应最典型的发作窗口。

points.en: Approach is the same as any patient, plus a wider net: ask about dizziness, fatigue, syncope, dyspnea, chest pain, palpitations, hemoptysis, visual changes, whether pain is body-wide or localized, skin colour change, itching, and joint stiffness.
points.zh: 评估框架和其他病人一样，只是要多撒一层网：问头晕、乏力、晕厥、呼吸困难、胸痛、心悸、咯血、视觉改变、疼痛是全身还是局部、皮肤变色、瘙痒、关节僵硬。

points.en: Bleeding-specific questions: gum or nose bleeding, blood in urine or stool — and because some patients hide a hematologic diagnosis out of fear of being treated differently, keep the tone nonjudgmental.
points.zh: 出血相关的专项提问：牙龈或鼻出血、尿血便血——而且有些病人会因为怕被区别对待而隐瞒血液病病史，问诊语气必须不带评判。

points.en: Physical exam red flags by system: LOC swings from agitation to unresponsiveness; skin shows uncontrolled bleeding, chronic bruising, pallor, or jaundice; GI shows bleeding gums, ulcers, or melena; skeletal shows chronic joint/bone pain.
points.zh: 各系统体查红旗：意识可以从躁动摆到无反应；皮肤有失控出血、慢性瘀斑、苍白或黄疸；消化道有牙龈出血、溃疡或黑便；骨骼系统有慢性关节骨痛。

points.en: More red flags: visual disturbances (blurred vision, tunnel vision, black/grey spots), cardiovascular signs (dyspnea, tachycardia, chest pain), genitourinary signs (hematuria, menorrhagia, recurring infection), and respiratory signs (epistaxis, hemoptysis).
points.zh: 还有：视觉障碍（视物模糊、管状视野、黑影灰点）、心血管征象（呼吸困难、心动过速、胸痛）、泌尿生殖征象（血尿、月经过多、反复感染）、呼吸道征象（鼻衄、咯血）。

points.en: Bedside trick for anemia: check the conjunctiva for pallor — a pale conjunctiva suggests low hematocrit/RBC count, though this sign only works on skin that is currently at normal temperature.
points.zh: 贫血床边快查：翻眼睑看结膜是否苍白——结膜苍白提示血细胞比容/红细胞计数偏低，但这个体征只在皮肤温度正常时才可靠。

points.en: The seven-part general management skeleton: oxygen scaled to severity, IV fluids as the specific disorder demands, ECG monitoring for symptomatic dysrhythmias, transport to the closest appropriate facility, comfort positioning and warmth, pain control (often needed aggressively in sickle-cell crisis), and psychological support.
points.zh: 通用处置七件套：按严重度给氧、按具体病种补液、心电监护处理有症状的心律失常、送最近的合适医院、摆舒适体位并保暖、镇痛（镰状细胞危象往往需要下重手）、心理支持。

points.en: Default transport is gentle and unhurried; escalate to rapid transport only if LOC abruptly changes, hypotension develops, or other perfusion red flags appear.
points.zh: 默认转运方式是轻柔不赶——只有意识骤变、出现低血压或其他灌注红旗时，才升级为快速转运。

sections.titleZh: 贫血、地中海贫血与红细胞增多症

points.en: Anemia means hemoglobin or RBC count below normal, arriving by three routes: blood loss (acute or chronic), reduced production, or increased RBC destruction (hemolysis) — usually riding on top of another underlying disease.
points.zh: 贫血＝血红蛋白或红细胞计数低于正常，成因三条路：失血（急性或慢性）、生成减少、破坏增多（溶血）——通常还搭着另一个基础疾病。

points.en: Iron deficiency anemia is the most common type; top causes are GI blood loss, menstrual blood loss, and repeated blood draws or donations during a long hospitalization.
points.zh: 缺铁性贫血是最常见的贫血类型；主要成因是消化道失血、月经失血，以及长期住院反复抽血或献血。

points.en: Anemia's classic complaint trio: worn-out fatigue, can't-catch-breath dyspnea, and sometimes angina-like chest pain from reduced oxygen delivery to heart muscle — low WBC and low platelets can tag along, driving infections and easy bruising.
points.zh: 贫血的经典主诉三件套：疲惫不堪、喘不上气、有时还有类似心绞痛的胸痛（心肌供氧不足）——还可能捎带白细胞和血小板偏低，带来感染和易瘀伤。

points.en: Genetic hemoglobin disorders fall into two camps: production disorders (thalassemia, too little globin chain made) and structure disorders (sickle cell, the hemoglobin itself is malformed) — both shorten RBC lifespan and can create vessel-clogging deformed cells.
points.zh: 遗传性血红蛋白病分两大阵营：生成障碍（地中海贫血，珠蛋白链造得不够）和结构障碍（镰状细胞病，血红蛋白本身长歪了）——两者都会缩短红细胞寿命，还可能生出堵血管的畸形细胞。

points.en: G6PD deficiency (an enzyme that shields cells during infection) is most reported in African and Southern European populations but can occur in anyone; low levels leave RBCs vulnerable to damage.
points.zh: G6PD 缺乏症（一种感染时保护细胞的酶）在非裔和南欧裔人群报告最多，但任何族裔都可能发生；酶不足会让红细胞更容易受损。

points.en: Beta-thalassemia major: both parents are carriers, the infant looks healthy for up to 3 years, then severe anemia forces regular transfusions — which in turn cause iron overload needing chelation therapy; untreated patients typically die in their 20s-30s.
points.zh: 重型 β 地中海贫血：父母双方都是携带者，婴儿前 3 年看着健康，之后重度贫血逼出规律输血——输血又造成铁过载、需要驱铁治疗；不治疗多在二三十岁死亡。

points.en: Alpha-thalassemia (common in Southeast Asian, also African/Mediterranean descent) affects about 5-30% of African Canadians and 15-30% of Southeast Asians as carriers; a four-gene deletion causes fatal hydrops fetalis, and the mother faces higher risk of toxemia and postpartum hemorrhage.
points.zh: α 地中海贫血（东南亚裔多见，也见于非裔和地中海裔）在非裔加拿大人中约 5-30% 带因、东南亚裔约 15-30%；四个基因全缺会导致致死性胎儿水肿，母亲还面临更高的妊娠毒血症和产后出血风险。

points.en: Polycythemia is the mirror image of anemia: RBC overproduction thickens and expands blood volume, raising clot risk (stroke, TIA, DVT, PE, MI) — treatment target is hematocrit under 45% in men and under 42% in women, usually via phlebotomy.
points.zh: 红细胞增多症是贫血的镜像：红细胞造太多让血液变稠、血容量变大，血栓风险随之上升（卒中、TIA、DVT、肺栓塞、心梗）——治疗目标是把血细胞比容压到男 <45%、女 <42%，通常靠放血疗法。

points.en: Polycythemia's tell: purplish skin with red hands and feet, itching (pruritus), tachycardia as the dominant rhythm change, and possible altered LOC from a stroke-like event — but treat whatever acute complaint brought the call, not the underlying diagnosis.
points.zh: 红细胞增多症的招牌：皮肤发紫、手脚发红、瘙痒、心动过速是最常见的心律改变，还可能因类卒中事件出现意识改变——但当场要治的是引发这通呼叫的急性主诉，不是这个基础诊断本身。

points.en: Sickle cell disease is Canada's most common inherited blood disorder; the carrier gene frequency among Black Canadians runs at least 1 in 10, tracking the higher carrier rates of their countries of origin.
points.zh: 镰状细胞病是加拿大最常见的遗传性血液病；加拿大黑人群体的携带基因频率至少十分之一，与其原籍地更高的携带率一脉相承。

points.en: Regional carrier rates behind that number: Caribbean 10-14%, West African 20-25% — context for why the disease shows up disproportionately in Black Canadian communities.
points.zh: 背后的区域携带率：加勒比 10-14%，西非 20-25%——这解释了为什么这个病在加拿大黑人社区出现的比例格外高。

points.en: Mortality peaks between ages 1 and 3, most often from sepsis caused by Streptococcus pneumoniae — after infancy, patients live with chronic anemia punctuated by acute crises.
points.zh: 死亡高峰在 1-3 岁，多因肺炎链球菌引发的脓毒症——熬过婴儿期后，病人就是慢性贫血叠加急性危象地过日子。

points.en: Mechanism: abnormal hemoglobin sticks together and bends the RBC from a disc into a sickle/spindle shape; these cells die early (causing anemia) and can lodge in small vessels — hypoxia itself makes the sickling worse, a vicious circle.
points.zh: 机制：异常血红蛋白互相粘连，把红细胞从圆盘掰成镰刀/纺锤形；这些细胞早夭（造成贫血）还会卡在小血管里——而缺氧本身又会让镰变加重，形成恶性循环。

points.en: Five named crisis types to keep straight: painful/vaso-occlusive (vessel blockage causing pain or stroke), sequestration (spleen suddenly enlarges and traps blood), chest (lung injury with severe hypoxia), aplastic (viral infection halts RBC production), and hemolytic (drugs/toxins/stress trigger rapid RBC breakdown).
points.zh: 五种命名危象要分清：痛性/血管闭塞危象（血管堵塞致痛或卒中）、隔离危象（脾突然肿大扣血）、胸危象（肺损伤伴重度缺氧）、再生障碍危象（病毒感染暂停红细胞生成）、溶血危象（药物/毒物/应激触发红细胞快速破坏）。

points.en: Splenic sequestration is the one to fear on exam: left-upper-quadrant tenderness plus a palpable spleen in a sickle-cell patient means urgent transport and an early call ahead to the receiving facility.
points.zh: 脾隔离危象是考试最爱盯的一种：镰状细胞病人出现左上腹压痛加脾脏可触及，就意味着要紧急转运并提前电话通知接收医院。

points.en: Do not dismiss a sickle-cell call as 'just another crisis': patients present with life-threatening potential, shortness of breath, pneumonia-like signs, poor perfusion skin signs, hypotension, and sometimes jaundice or icteric sclera.
points.zh: 别把镰状细胞病人的呼叫当「又是一次老毛病」打发：病人可能真有致命风险，表现为呼吸困难、类肺炎征象、灌注差的皮肤表现、低血压，有时还有黄疸或眼白发黄。

points.en: Treatment core: high-flow oxygen (limits further sickling from hypoxia), IV fluids for the dehydration that drives crises, and aggressive analgesia — years of living with the disease often raise the patient's pain threshold, meaning they typically need MORE analgesia, not less.
points.zh: 处置核心：高流量给氧（减少缺氧驱动的进一步镰变）、静脉补液纠正诱发危象的脱水、还有下重手镇痛——常年带病生活往往把病人的痛阈值抬高，意味着他们通常需要更多镇痛，而不是更少。

points.en: Exam trap: sickle cell crisis can mimic appendicitis or opioid withdrawal — do not let either mimicry talk you out of treating the pain as real and the crisis as serious.
points.zh: 考试陷阱：镰状细胞危象可以酷似阑尾炎或阿片戒断——别让这两种「像什么」动摇你把疼痛当真、把危象当重症来处理的判断。

sections.titleEn: Leukemia, Lymphoma, Multiple Myeloma, and Neutropenia
sections.titleZh: 白血病、淋巴瘤、多发性骨髓瘤与中性粒细胞减少

points.en: Neutropenia (too few neutrophils, the front-line bacteria fighters) is most often seen in cancer patients after chemotherapy — febrile neutropenia can rocket into sepsis and is a medical emergency needing prompt care.
points.zh: 中性粒细胞减少（一线抗菌兵力不足）在化疗后的癌症病人身上最常见——发热性中性粒细胞减少可能急转直下变成脓毒症，是需要马上处理的急症。

points.en: Leukemia is WBC cancer: cells develop abnormally/excessively, producing anemia, thrombocytopenia, and leukocytosis together, while the chemotherapy used to treat it paradoxically causes leukopenia.
points.zh: 白血病是白细胞的癌变：细胞异常或过度增殖，同时带出贫血、血小板减少和白细胞增多——而治疗它的化疗又会反过来造成白细胞减少。

points.en: Acute vs chronic leukemia: acute replaces marrow with abnormal lymphoblasts and can strike children or older adults; chronic accumulates mature abnormal cells and skews toward patients 65 and older, often found incidentally on routine bloodwork.
points.zh: 急性 vs 慢性白血病：急性型让骨髓被异常淋巴母细胞取代，儿童和老年人都可能中招；慢性型是成熟异常细胞慢慢堆积，偏好 65 岁以上人群，常常是常规验血意外发现的。

points.en: Cure-rate gap worth remembering: about 80% of children survive leukemia when caught and treated early, versus only 30-40% for adults at best, largely because of age-related genetic abnormalities.
points.zh: 治愈率差距值得记住：儿童白血病早发现早治疗治愈率约 80%，成人最好也只有 30-40%，主要归咎于年龄相关的基因异常更多。

points.en: Leukemia patients can be immunocompromised enough that a provider's mild cold could be fatal to them — mask up, and treat any fever in a leukemia/post-chemo patient as potentially serious even without other obvious infection signs.
points.zh: 白血病病人的免疫力可能低到连你的一场小感冒都能要他的命——记得戴口罩，且白血病/化疗后病人的发热哪怕没有其他明显感染征象也要当回事。

points.en: Lymphoma splits into non-Hodgkin (most cases, any age, ranges from indolent to highly aggressive) and Hodgkin (painless progressive lymph-node swelling, two incidence peaks at 15-35 and after 55-60).
points.zh: 淋巴瘤分非霍奇金（大多数病例，任何年龄，从惰性到高度侵袭性都有）和霍奇金（无痛渐进性淋巴结肿大，发病年龄两个高峰：15-35 岁和 55-60 岁以后）。

points.en: Hodgkin lymphoma's silent build-up: years with no symptoms before night sweats, chills, persistent cough, and neck-first lymph-node swelling surface — yet 60-90% of patients are cured with aggressive chemo/radiation, one of the first cancers ever cured this way.
points.zh: 霍奇金淋巴瘤会安静潜伏多年，之后才冒出盗汗、寒战、持续咳嗽和从颈部开始的淋巴结肿大——但激进化放疗下 60-90% 的病人能被治愈，它是最早被这种方式治愈的癌症之一。

points.en: Lymphoma call priorities: expect pallor, possible lower-lung congestion, hot-then-cold sensations, poor-perfusion vitals (low BP with high HR), and pain severe enough that the patient is likely already on a high-dose analgesic regimen — treat aggressively.
points.zh: 淋巴瘤病人的处置重点：多半苍白、可能有肺底充血、忽冷忽热、灌注差的生命体征（低血压伴心率快），且疼痛往往重到病人本来就在用高剂量镇痛方案——镇痛要跟得上。

points.en: Multiple myeloma: plasma-cell tumours crowd the marrow, tanking RBC/WBC/platelet production and causing anemia plus infection susceptibility; bone tumours cause spontaneous fractures and back pain, mostly in patients over 40, more often men.
points.zh: 多发性骨髓瘤：浆细胞肿瘤挤占骨髓，把红白细胞和血小板生成都压下去，造成贫血兼易感染；骨内肿瘤会引发自发性骨折和背痛，好发 40 岁以上，男性更多见。

sections.titleEn: Coagulation Disorders: DIC, Hemophilia, and Anticoagulant-Related Bleeding
sections.titleZh: 凝血障碍：DIC、血友病与抗凝药相关出血

points.en: DIC (disseminated intravascular coagulopathy) is triggered by massive trauma with hypotension, sepsis, or obstetric catastrophes — it runs two stages: first clotting factors get consumed forming widespread clots, then uncontrolled hemorrhage follows once those factors run out.
points.zh: DIC（弥散性血管内凝血）常由重创伤合并低血压、脓毒症或产科灾难触发——分两幕：先是凝血因子被大量消耗、全身到处形成微血栓，因子耗尽后紧接着就是止不住的出血。

points.en: DIC mortality in acute cases has been reported as high as 75%, driven mainly by uncontrolled bleeding, hypotension, and shock — recognize the pattern (multi-organ failure plus bleeding from IV sites, joints, or intracranially) even though field treatment is only supportive.
points.zh: 急性 DIC 的死亡率有报道高达 75%，死因主要是止不住的出血、低血压和休克——要认得这个模式（多器官衰竭同时伴静脉穿刺点/关节/颅内出血），即使院前只能做支持治疗。

points.en: Hemophilia is X-linked, mostly affecting males, split by which clotting factor is missing: type A lacks factor VIII, type B (Christmas disease) lacks factor IX — both look the same clinically and both can bleed acutely or chronically, spontaneously or after trivial injury.
points.zh: 血友病是 X 连锁遗传，主要影响男性，按缺哪个凝血因子分型：A 型缺 VIII 因子，B 型（圣诞病）缺 IX 因子——两型临床表现一样，都能自发或因轻微损伤而急慢性出血。

points.en: Spontaneous intracranial hemorrhage is a leading cause of death in hemophilia — any head injury or new headache in a known hemophiliac gets treated as a real bleed until proven otherwise, and severe episodes need hospital factor VIII/IX infusion plus transfusion.
points.zh: 自发性颅内出血是血友病病人的主要死因之一——已知血友病人出现头外伤或新发头痛，都要当真出血处理直到排除，重度发作需要住院输注 VIII/IX 因子并输血。

points.en: Von Willebrand disease belongs in the same bleeding-disorder family as hemophilia: clotting happens, just insufficiently — same field approach (protect ABCs, watch for pallor/weak pulse/hypotension, cover for warmth, gentle handling).
points.zh: 血管性血友病和血友病同属一个出血性疾病家族：能凝血，只是凝得不够——院前处理思路一样（守住 ABC、盯苍白/脉弱/低血压这些急性失血信号、保暖、动作轻柔）。

points.en: The single highest-yield real-world scenario in this chapter: an elderly patient on warfarin or a DOAC (apixaban, rivaroxaban, dabigatran) with a 'minor' fall or head bump is never minor — anticoagulation means even a small vessel tear keeps oozing instead of self-sealing.
points.zh: 这一章现实中最高频的实战场景：老年人服用华法林或新型口服抗凝药（阿哌沙班、利伐沙班、达比加群）后一次「不算什么」的跌倒或磕头，永远不是小事——抗凝状态下，哪怕血管只是小裂口也会持续渗血而不是自行封住。

points.en: Why it's dangerous: brain atrophy with age leaves extra room inside the skull for a slowly expanding subdural hematoma to grow silently before symptoms appear — the patient can 'talk and die', looking fine on scene and deteriorating hours later.
points.zh: 危险在哪：老年人脑萎缩给颅内腾出了额外空间，硬膜下血肿可以悄悄扩大很久才出现症状——病人可能「先清醒后猝死」，现场看着没事，几小时后才恶化。

points.en: Field rule: any anticoagulated patient with a head strike gets treated as a probable evolving intracranial bleed regardless of a normal initial GCS or a seemingly trivial mechanism — do not let a reassuring first assessment cancel transport.
points.zh: 院前铁律：任何服抗凝药的病人一旦头部受击，都按可能正在扩大的颅内出血处理，不管首次 GCS 多正常、机制看起来多轻微——一次让人安心的初评不能成为不转运的理由。

points.en: Reversal logic (hospital-side, good to know): warfarin reversal for serious bleeding favours prothrombin complex concentrate (PCC) over plasma, usually paired with 10 mg IV vitamin K; DOACs lack a reliable point-of-care test like INR, so their bleeding risk is harder to gauge in the field.
points.zh: 逆转逻辑（医院端知识，但要懂）：华法林严重出血逆转首选凝血酶原复合物浓缩剂（PCC）而非血浆，通常搭配 10 mg 静脉维生素 K；新型口服抗凝药没有像 INR 这样可靠的床旁检测，院前更难判断实际出血风险。

points.en: BC's own drug list quietly confirms the risk: aspirin, ibuprofen, and TXA all carry an explicit caution or contraindication for patients already on anticoagulants — a reminder that this population needs extra scrutiny before any antiplatelet/pro-hemostatic drug on scene.
points.zh: BC 的药物单本身就默默印证了这个风险：阿司匹林、布洛芬和 TXA 全都对「正在服抗凝药」的病人写了明确的注意事项或禁忌——提醒你对这类病人使用任何抗血小板/促凝药物前都要多一分警惕。

sections.titleEn: Transfusion of Blood and Blood Products

points.en: Packed RBCs restore both oxygen-carrying capacity and circulating volume; one unit typically raises hemoglobin by about 10 g/L, and the decision to transfuse should never rest on the Hgb number alone.
points.zh: 浓缩红细胞同时恢复携氧能力和循环血量；一个单位通常能把血红蛋白抬高约 10 g/L，但输不输绝不能只看这一个数字。

points.en: Ontario's threshold ladder for non-bleeding patients: Hgb under 60 g/L, transfusion is likely appropriate; under 70 g/L, consider it; under 80 g/L, consider only with cardiovascular disease or impaired tissue oxygenation; 80-90 g/L, likely inappropriate unless there is evidence of impaired oxygenation; over 90 g/L, likely inappropriate outright — transfuse one unit at a time and recheck.
points.zh: 安大略非出血病人的输血阶梯：Hgb <60 g/L 基本该输；<70 g/L 考虑输；<80 g/L 只有合并心血管病或组织缺氧证据才考虑；80-90 g/L 除非有组织缺氧证据否则不该输；>90 g/L 直接不该输——每次只输一个单位再复查。

points.en: For actively bleeding patients the target flips to keeping Hgb above 70 g/L (above 80 g/L with pre-existing cardiovascular disease) rather than chasing a fixed transfusion trigger.
points.zh: 对活动性出血的病人，目标改成把 Hgb 维持在 70 g/L 以上（有心血管病基础则 80 g/L 以上），而不是死盯一个固定的输血触发值。

points.en: Fresh frozen plasma carries the clotting factors; key triggers are INR above 1.7 with significant bleeding, INR above 1.5-2.0 with microvascular bleeding or massive transfusion, or urgent warfarin reversal with serious bleeding (INR above 1.5) — typical dose 3-4 units.
points.zh: 新鲜冰冻血浆携带凝血因子；主要触发条件是 INR>1.7 伴显著出血、INR>1.5-2.0 伴微血管出血或大量输血、或需紧急逆转华法林且有严重出血（INR>1.5）——常规剂量 3-4 单位。

points.en: Platelet transfusion threshold: consider under 50 x10^9/L if bleeding is ongoing, and give it regardless once the count drops under 20 x10^9/L — other triggers include major surgery, head trauma, and marked bleeding from antiplatelet drug use.
points.zh: 血小板输注阈值：有活动性出血、计数 <50×10^9/L 就该考虑，一旦跌破 20×10^9/L 无论如何都要输——其他触发因素还包括大手术、头部创伤和抗血小板药物导致的明显出血。

points.en: Transfusion risk isn't evenly spread: a febrile nonhemolytic reaction to platelets runs about 1 in 20, minor allergic reaction 1 in 100 — but a fatal ABO-mismatch hemolytic reaction is roughly 1 in 40,000 and HIV transmission is down to about 1 in 7.8 million.
points.zh: 输血风险分布很不均匀：血小板发热性非溶血反应约 1/20，轻度过敏约 1/100——但 ABO 错配导致的致死性溶血反应约 1/40,000，HIV 传播风险已降到约 1/780 万。

points.en: Paramedics need direct medical control authorization before administering blood products, though some services allow starting packed RBCs before physician contact in defined emergencies; meanwhile prehospital blood products and hospital massive hemorrhage protocols are both expanding because blood loss remains a leading cause of death after trauma, postpartum hemorrhage, and major GI bleeds — know your local policy and be ready to activate the receiving hospital's protocol.
points.zh: 输血制品前需要在线医疗指导授权，不过部分单位在特定急症下允许在联系医生前就先开始输浓缩红细胞；与此同时院前血制品和医院的大量输血协议都在扩大使用，因为失血依然是创伤后、产后出血和消化道大出血死亡的头号原因之一——要清楚本地政策，并知道怎样提前激活接收医院的协议。

atScene.en: Fibrinolytic ('clot-buster') therapy activates the body's own plasmin system or hits the clot directly — used for AMI, acute ischemic stroke, and large PE; anyone who received it needs close bleeding watch since the lysis isn't clot-specific.
atScene.zh: 溶栓（「溶血栓」）治疗要么激活身体自身的纤溶酶系统、要么直接打在血栓上——用于急性心梗、急性缺血性卒中和大面积肺栓塞；打过溶栓的病人要密切盯出血，因为溶解作用不挑血栓。

atScene.en: Quick anemia screen: pull down the lower eyelid and look at the conjunctiva — pale conjunctiva suggests low RBC/hematocrit, but only when the skin is currently at normal temperature.
atScene.zh: 贫血快速筛查：翻下眼睑看结膜——结膜苍白提示红细胞/血细胞比容偏低，但前提是皮肤当下温度正常。

atScene.en: Translate the lab pattern at the bedside: low WBC (leukopenia) shows up as infection and fever; low platelets (thrombocytopenia) shows up as skin bleeding (including petechiae) and mucous-membrane bleeding (nosebleeds, rectal bleeding); anemia shows up as fatigue, lethargy, dyspnea.
atScene.zh: 把化验模式翻译成床边体征：白细胞低（白细胞减少）表现为感染发热；血小板低（血小板减少）表现为皮肤出血（含瘀点）和黏膜出血（鼻衄、便血）；贫血表现为乏力、萎靡、呼吸困难。

atScene.en: DIC's whole-body signature: multiple organs (kidney, lung, heart) failing at once, plus bleeding from IV sites, into joints, and possibly intracranially — one patient, several simultaneous crises.
atScene.zh: DIC 的全身签名：肾、肺、心多个器官同时衰竭，外加静脉穿刺点出血、关节内出血、可能还有颅内出血——一个病人身上好几场危机同时开打。

atScene.en: Sickle cell disease is a great imitator: it can present just like appendicitis (abdominal pain) or opioid withdrawal (restlessness, pain-seeking behaviour) — don't let either mimicry stop you from treating a real crisis seriously.
atScene.zh: 镰状细胞病是个模仿高手：能装得像阑尾炎（腹痛）或阿片戒断（躁动、索药行为）——别让这两种「像什么」阻止你认真对待一次真的危象。

atScene.en: A splenomegaly finding matters: left-upper-quadrant tenderness with a palpable spleen border can signal splenic sequestration in sickle cell disease, or simply an enlarged spleen from infection/cancer/hemolysis — either way it earns rapid transport and an early call to the receiving facility.
atScene.zh: 脾大是个重要发现：左上腹压痛加能摸到脾脏边缘，在镰状细胞病人身上可能是脾隔离危象，也可能只是感染/肿瘤/溶血引起的脾大——不管哪种都值得快速转运并提前联系接收医院。

confusions.en: 'Low platelets means transfuse platelets now' — wrong: the trigger is under 50 x10^9/L WITH ongoing bleeding, or under 20 x10^9/L regardless; a low number alone without bleeding is not automatic.
confusions.zh: 「血小板低就该马上输血小板」——错：触发条件是 <50×10^9/L 且有活动性出血，或跌破 20×10^9/L 才无论如何都输；单纯数字低、没有出血不是自动指征。

confusions.en: 'Low Hgb means transfuse' — the source table explicitly warns not to transfuse based on Hgb alone; symptoms, bleeding status, and cardiovascular history all shape the decision.
confusions.zh: 「Hgb 低就该输血」——原始依据表明确警告不能只看 Hgb 数值下结论；症状、是否在出血、心血管病史都会改变这个决定。

confusions.en: 'O blood and AB blood are both universal' — true for opposite components only: O is the universal RBC donor, AB the universal RBC recipient; for plasma the roles reverse.
confusions.zh: 「O 型血和 AB 型血都是万能的」——只在不同成分上各自成立：O 是红细胞万能供者，AB 是红细胞万能受者；到了血浆，角色整个反过来。

confusions.en: 'Hemophilia bleeding is only about visible wounds' — spontaneous intracranial hemorrhage and hemarthrosis are the real killers, often with no external wound at all.
confusions.zh: 「血友病出血就看得见的伤口」——自发性颅内出血和关节腔出血才是真正的杀手，往往根本没有外伤伤口。

confusions.en: 'No visible scalp wound after a fall means the anticoagulated elderly patient is fine' — a slowly expanding subdural hematoma can develop with zero external sign and a normal initial GCS.
confusions.zh: 「跌倒后头皮没伤口，抗凝老人就没事」——缓慢扩大的硬膜下血肿可以完全没有外部体征，首次 GCS 也可能完全正常。

confusions.en: 'A sickle-cell patient asking for strong pain relief is drug-seeking' — a dangerous bias; years with the disease typically raise pain tolerance, so real crisis pain is usually worse than it looks, not exaggerated.
confusions.zh: 「镰状细胞病人要求强效止痛就是索药」——这是危险的偏见；长期患病通常会抬高痛阈值，真实的危象痛往往比表面看起来更重，而不是夸张。

confusions.en: 'A mild fever after chemo can wait' — febrile neutropenia is a medical emergency that can rocket into sepsis within hours; treat it with urgency even if the patient looks otherwise well.
confusions.zh: 「化疗后低烧不用急」——发热性中性粒细胞减少是能在数小时内急转成脓毒症的急症，哪怕病人看起来其他方面都还好，也要当紧急情况处理。

confusions.en: 'DIC needs either an anticoagulant or a clot-promoting drug to fix it' — field management is supportive only (airway, oxygen, warmth, shock care, treat the underlying trigger) with no single field drug that solves both stages.
confusions.zh: 「DIC 要么该用抗凝药、要么该用促凝药来治」——院前处理只能是支持性的（气道、给氧、保暖、休克处理、处理诱因），没有哪一种院前药能同时解决两个阶段的问题。

confusions.en: 'A high INR always means give plasma' — current practice favours PCC over plasma for urgent warfarin reversal, reserving plasma for when PCC is unavailable or contraindicated (e.g., history of heparin-induced thrombocytopenia).
confusions.zh: 「INR 高就该给血浆」——目前紧急逆转华法林更优先用 PCC 而非血浆，只有在 PCC 不可用或有禁忌（如肝素诱导性血小板减少症病史）时才用血浆。

confusions.en: 'A call for a leukemia or lymphoma patient always needs aggressive resuscitation' — sometimes the family just needs support and information, not transport; document the discussion and get a refusal signed if that is the informed choice.
confusions.zh: 「白血病或淋巴瘤病人的呼叫都要拼命抢救」——有时家属只是需要支持和信息，不一定要转运；如果这是知情后的选择，要记录讨论过程并签好拒绝转运文件。

mnemonics.name: 痛隔胸再溶
mnemonics.en: Five sickle crises in order: Painful (vaso-occlusive), Sequestration (spleen traps blood), Chest (lung/hypoxia), Aplastic (marrow pauses), Hemolytic (rapid RBC breakdown).
mnemonics.zh: 五种镰状危象：痛（血管闭塞）、隔（脾隔离）、胸（肺/缺氧）、再（再障/骨髓暂停）、溶（溶血）——背作「痛隔胸再溶」。

mnemonics.name: A-8, B-9
mnemonics.en: Alphabetical-numerical pairing: Hemophilia A goes with factor VIII (8), Hemophilia B goes with factor IX (9) — A before B, 8 before 9.
mnemonics.zh: 字母数字对齐记：血友病 A 配 VIII 因子（8），血友病 B 配 IX 因子（9）——A 在 B 前，8 在 9 前。

mnemonics.name: O 给红细胞，AB 给血浆
mnemonics.en: For red cells O is the universal giver and AB the universal taker; for plasma the pairing flips — AB gives to everyone, O can only take from O.
mnemonics.zh: 红细胞：O 万能给、AB 万能收；血浆反过来：AB 万能给、O 只能收 O。

mnemonics.name: DIC = 先凝后崩
mnemonics.en: DIC's two acts in order: first the clotting cascade fires everywhere and eats up the factors, then — factors exhausted — uncontrolled bleeding takes over.
mnemonics.zh: DIC 两幕剧：先是凝血级联到处点火、把凝血因子耗光，然后——因子没了——止不住的出血接管全场。

mnemonics.name: 30-60 分钟盯梢
mnemonics.en: Transfusion-watch window: the first 30 to 60 minutes after starting is when a reaction is most likely to show its face.
mnemonics.zh: 输血盯梢窗口「30-60」：输血反应最容易在头 30 到 60 分钟内现形。

mnemonics.name: 老抗磕＝定时炸弹
mnemonics.en: Elderly + anticoagulated + head strike = a delayed-fuse bomb: normal right now does not mean safe later.
mnemonics.zh: 老年＋抗凝药＋磕头＝定时炸弹：现在正常不代表之后安全。

selfCheck.qEn: Name the five recognized sickle cell crisis types, and state the three-part core of prehospital treatment.
selfCheck.qZh: 说出镰状细胞病的五种危象类型，并说出院前处置的三大核心。
selfCheck.aEn: Painful/vaso-occlusive, sequestration, chest, aplastic, hemolytic. Core treatment: high-flow oxygen, IV fluids for dehydration, and aggressive analgesia (patients often have a high pain tolerance and need MORE analgesia, not less).
selfCheck.aZh: 痛性/血管闭塞、隔离、胸、再生障碍、溶血五型。核心处置：高流量给氧、静脉补液纠正脱水、下重手镇痛（病人痛阈值往往更高，需要更多而不是更少的镇痛）。

selfCheck.qEn: State the Ontario Hgb thresholds for transfusing a non-bleeding patient at both ends of the ladder, and the target for an actively bleeding patient.
selfCheck.qZh: 说出安大略输血阶梯里非出血病人两端的 Hgb 阈值，以及活动性出血病人的目标值。
selfCheck.aEn: Non-bleeding: Hgb under 60 g/L is likely appropriate to transfuse; over 90 g/L is likely inappropriate. Actively bleeding: keep Hgb above 70 g/L (above 80 g/L with pre-existing cardiovascular disease).
selfCheck.aZh: 非出血病人：Hgb <60 g/L 基本该输；>90 g/L 基本不该输。活动性出血病人：把 Hgb 维持在 >70 g/L（有心血管病基础则 >80 g/L）。

selfCheck.qEn: Why is a 'minor' fall or head bump in an elderly patient on warfarin or a DOAC never actually minor, and what is the field rule?
selfCheck.qZh: 为什么老年人服华法林或新型口服抗凝药后一次「不算什么」的跌倒或磕头从来不是小事？院前铁律是什么？
selfCheck.aEn: Anticoagulation stops small vessel tears from self-sealing, and age-related brain atrophy leaves room for a subdural hematoma to expand silently — the patient can 'talk and die' hours later. Field rule: treat any anticoagulated patient with a head strike as a probable evolving bleed regardless of a normal initial GCS, and do not skip transport.
selfCheck.aZh: 抗凝状态让小血管裂口无法自行封住，加上老年脑萎缩腾出的空间让硬膜下血肿能悄悄扩大——病人可能几小时后才「由清醒转崩溃」。院前铁律：任何抗凝病人头部受击都按可能正在扩大的出血处理，哪怕首次 GCS 完全正常，也不能因此不转运。

selfCheck.qEn: Describe DIC's two-stage mechanism and its reported mortality in acute cases.
selfCheck.qZh: 描述 DIC 的两阶段机制及其在急性病例中的报告死亡率。
selfCheck.aEn: Stage 1: the coagulation cascade fires widely, consuming clotting factors and platelets in diffuse clot formation. Stage 2: once factors are exhausted, uncontrolled hemorrhage takes over. Acute-case mortality has been reported as high as 75%.
selfCheck.aZh: 第一阶段：凝血级联全身点火，弥漫性血栓形成消耗凝血因子和血小板。第二阶段：因子耗尽后，止不住的出血接管全局。急性病例的死亡率报道最高达 75%。

selfCheck.qEn: Which factor is missing in hemophilia A versus B, and which ABO blood type is the universal RBC donor versus the universal plasma donor?
selfCheck.qZh: 血友病 A 型和 B 型分别缺哪个凝血因子？ABO 血型里红细胞万能供者和血浆万能供者分别是哪型？
selfCheck.aEn: Hemophilia A lacks factor VIII; hemophilia B (Christmas disease) lacks factor IX. For red cells, type O is the universal donor; for plasma, the roles flip and type AB is the universal donor.
selfCheck.aZh: 血友病 A 型缺 VIII 因子；B 型（圣诞病）缺 IX 因子。红细胞方面 O 型是万能供者；血浆方面角色反过来，AB 型才是万能供者。

bcAlerts.topicZh: 血液病/隐匿出血情境下的 TXA
bcAlerts.bookEn: The textbook barely mentions TXA and does not connect it to bleeding-disorder or anticoagulant-related hemorrhage at all.
bcAlerts.bookZh: 教材几乎不提 TXA，更没有把它和出血性疾病或抗凝药相关出血联系起来。
bcAlerts.bcEn: BC's TXA indication explicitly includes 'shock with suspected occult bleeding' — relevant to hemophilia and anticoagulant-related internal bleeding, not just trauma. Same dose/contraindications as covered in Ch.21: 2 g IV push over 1 minute; not for allergy, over 3 h post-injury, under 12, or isolated TBI.
bcAlerts.bcZh: BC 的 TXA 适应证明确包含「休克伴疑似隐匿出血」——不只适用于创伤，血友病和抗凝药相关的内出血同样适用。剂量禁忌与第 21 章一致：2 g 静推、用时 1 分钟；过敏、伤后超 3 小时、12 岁以下、孤立性 TBI 均禁用。

bcAlerts.topicEn: Antiplatelet/NSAID use in anticoagulated or bleeding-disorder patients
bcAlerts.topicZh: 抗凝/出血性疾病病人使用抗血小板药与 NSAID
bcAlerts.bookEn: No BC-specific caution list exists in the Nancy chapter — it just generally notes NSAIDs and herbs impair platelets.
bcAlerts.bookZh: Nancy 教材本章没有 BC 式的具体禁忌清单——只泛泛提到 NSAID 和草本会削弱血小板功能。
bcAlerts.bcEn: BC's monographs are explicit: ASA is cautioned (flag it, not necessarily withheld) in patients with recent internal bleeding, known bleeding disease, current anticoagulant use, recent surgery, or possible pregnancy. Ibuprofen is contraindicated outright in patients on anticoagulants, active GI bleed/ulcer, or pregnancy.
bcAlerts.bcZh: BC 药物单写得很具体：阿司匹林对近期内出血、已知出血性疾病、正在服抗凝药、近期手术、可能妊娠的病人要谨慎（需要留意但不一定禁用）；布洛芬则对正在服抗凝药、活动性消化道出血/溃疡、妊娠的病人直接禁用。
bcAlerts.ref: BC Guidelines p.60 Aspirin / p.68-69 Ibuprofen

bcAlerts.topicEn: Methoxyflurane (Penthrox) restrictions relevant to bleeding/hematologic patients
bcAlerts.topicZh: 美氧氟烷（Penthrox）对出血/血液病病人的限制
bcAlerts.bookEn: Not covered in this textbook chapter at all — Nancy's hematologic chapter simply says 'analgesics may be needed.'
bcAlerts.bookZh: 本教材章节完全没提这个药——Nancy 只说「可能需要镇痛药」。
bcAlerts.bcEn: Penthrox is contraindicated in decreased LOC or head injury, plus known renal impairment — both scenarios that show up in this chapter (hemophilia ICH, sickle-cell altered mentation, myeloma-related renal disease), so it is often NOT an option for exactly the patients who need pain control most.
bcAlerts.bcZh: Penthrox 对意识下降或头部外伤、以及已知肾功能不全均属禁忌——而这两种情况恰好在本章反复出现（血友病颅内出血、镰状细胞病人意识改变、骨髓瘤相关肾病），所以往往正是最需要镇痛的病人用不了这个药。

bcAlerts.topicEn: No opioid analgesics at BC PCP scope
bcAlerts.topicZh: BC PCP 用药范围内没有阿片类镇痛药
bcAlerts.bookEn: The textbook implies opioid-level analgesia for sickle-cell crisis ('patients often require a higher level of analgesia') without flagging any scope limitation.
bcAlerts.bookZh: 教材暗示镰状细胞危象需要阿片类级别的镇痛（「病人常需要更高级别的镇痛」），完全没提执业范围的限制。
bcAlerts.bcEn: BC's PCP drug list in this guideline has no opioid analgesic at all — the actual toolkit is acetaminophen (PO/IV), ibuprofen (PO, but contraindicated with anticoagulants/active GI bleed/pregnancy), and methoxyflurane (Penthrox, itself contraindicated with altered LOC/head injury/renal impairment). Severe sickle-cell pain often outruns what a PCP can legally give — know this ceiling and request medical control support accordingly.
bcAlerts.bcZh: BC 这份 PCP 用药指引里完全没有阿片类镇痛药——实际工具箱只有对乙酰氨基酚（口服/静脉）、布洛芬（口服，但抗凝药/活动性消化道出血/妊娠禁用）和美氧氟烷（Penthrox，本身对意识改变/头外伤/肾功能不全禁用）。重度镰状细胞疼痛常常超出 PCP 合法能给的范围——认清这个天花板，按需请示在线医疗指导。

bcAlerts.topicEn: Oxygen dosing for anemia/sickle cell/hematologic shock
bcAlerts.topicZh: 贫血/镰状细胞/血液病休克的给氧策略
bcAlerts.bookEn: The chapter repeatedly says 'administer high-flow oxygen' or '15 L/min via nonrebreathing mask' as a blanket instruction for anemia, sickle cell, and leukemia patients.
bcAlerts.bookZh: 本章反复写「给高流量氧」或「非重复呼吸面罩 15 L/min」，把它当成贫血、镰状细胞、白血病病人的统一医嘱。
bcAlerts.bcEn: BC's standard is a titrated saturation target, not a fixed flow: give supplemental oxygen to keep SpO2 at or above 94%. Answer exam questions with the saturation target, matching the same standard used for shock/hypovolemia (Ch.21).
bcAlerts.bcZh: BC 的标准是滴定饱和度目标，不是固定流量：给氧以维持 SpO2 ≥94% 为准。答题答饱和度目标，与休克/低血容量（第 21 章）用的是同一套标准。
bcAlerts.ref: BC Guidelines p.54 Hypovolemia / general SpO2 94% standard

bcAlerts.bookEn: Not covered in Nancy's hematologic chapter — transfusion of plasma is described only as a generic clotting-factor replacement.
bcAlerts.bookZh: Nancy 血液系统急症章节完全没讲这个——只把血浆描述成一种笼统的凝血因子替代品。
bcAlerts.bcEn: The Ontario clinical practice table cited in this chapter's transfusion section gives concrete triggers: INR above 1.7 with significant bleeding needs 3-4 units FFP; urgent warfarin reversal with serious bleeding and INR above 1.5 should use PCC over plasma unless PCC is unavailable/contraindicated (e.g., HIT history), paired with 10 mg IV vitamin K.
bcAlerts.bcZh: 本章输血部分引用的安大略临床实践表给出了具体触发点：INR>1.7 伴显著出血需要 3-4 单位新鲜冰冻血浆；紧急逆转华法林且有严重出血、INR>1.5 时，优先用 PCC 而非血浆（除非 PCC 不可用或有禁忌如 HIT 病史），并搭配 10 mg 静脉维生素 K。
bcAlerts.ref: Table 37-5 / Ontario Regional Blood Coordinating Network
